title: A Stray Kids Children’s Book Just Dropped Online & the Cover Has Us Swooning
summary: STAY of all ages can pick up this illustrated biography, which tells the story of how the K-pop idols came together and found success.
contentText:

It’s been a big year for Stray Kids, as the K-pop group released new album THIS & THAT while taking the group’s music on the road to people across the world, including a headlining Governors Ball set in New York earlier this summer, and an upcoming headlining gig at Brazil’s Rock in Rio festival .

Now, Stray Kids fans have another reason to celebrate the group with the release of its first-ever children’s book.

NEW RELEASE

'Stray Kids: A Little Golden Book Biography'

$6.51

Buy Now ON AMAZON

Stray Kids: A Little Golden Book Biography is the latest release in publisher Golden Books’ collection of mini biographies about popular entertainers.

This book celebrates Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, Han, Felix, Seungmin and I.N., with 24 pages that tell the story of their rise to fame through easy-to-read text and full-color illustrations. (Could the guys look any more adorable?) As a book description teases, the Little Golden Book Biography tells the story of “each member of the K-pop boy band from their childhood, to their early days training together, to becoming global superstars. Learn how they work as a team, push creative boundaries and connect with fans around the world through their chart-topping albums and record-breaking tours.”

The Stray Kids Little Golden Book is written by longtime K-pop fan Talia Tucker, with new illustrations by Suji Park. Though it’s written for readers ages 4-8, the colorful hardcover picture book makes a great collectible or gift for STAY of all ages.

The new book is available to pre-order now on Amazon for just $6 with an expected release date in 2027.

'My Little Golden Book About K-Pop'

$5.58

Don’t want to wait? Stray Kids are also mentioned in this Little Golden Book, which chronicles the rise of K-pop through the years, from the first introduction of the genre to audiences, to third-gen groups such as BTS and BLACKPINK, and fourth-gen leaders including Stray Kids.

The 24-page picture book tells the story of “the music, the movies, the fandoms and the history that made K-pop a global sensation,” per a product description.

Amazon

Both books are part of the bestselling Little Golden Biography series, which has also features kid-friendly releases on BTS , Taylor Swift and Sabrina Carpenter , among others.

As for Stray Kids, eight of the group’s  Billboard 200  chart entries have  debuted at No. 1 so far, beginning with the mini-album  ODDINARY  in 2022, and latest release THIS & THAT could continue that streak. The group next heads to Japan and Colombia before playing Brazil. You can find Stray Kids tickets here .
